features.name: Kong gateway → ExtremeRouter model enumeration & chat routing fix
features.behavior: Kong proxy (8090) forwards ExtremeRouter's remote API key upstream and serves /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions to agents (Hermes, OpenCode) authenticated via per-consumer key-auth keys.

evidence.command: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/models -H "apikey: $(sops -d layers/00-cyberia/03-treasure/secrets/external_services.yaml | grep '^kong_key_hermes' | awk '{print $2}')" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]))'
evidence.output: 538 — Kong proxy now enumerates 538 ExtremeRouter models over HTTP (was 426 https-only + 401 no-upstream-auth).

features.name: Deactivate Qdrant + ChromaDB fleet-wide (keep modules)
features.behavior: services.ai-services.{qdrant,chromadb}.enable evaluate to false on both z0r0 and luffy; module files retained for possible re-enable.

evidence.command: nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.z0r0.config.services.ai-services.chromadb.enable && nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.luffy.config.services.ai-services.chromadb.enable && nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.luffy.config.services.ai-services.qdrant.enable && nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.z0r0.config.services.ai-services.qdrant.enable
evidence.output: false / false / false / false — all four evaluations return false. Modules (chromadb.nix, qdrant.nix) retained. Stale qdrant=6333 reverseProxy route removed from luffy. Both z0r0+luffy toplevels eval clean.

features.name: Retire EverOS + context-forge; consolidate to Honcho + brain-service + memory-vault
features.behavior: layers.layer-20.services.{everos,context-forge}.enable evaluate to false on z0r0 and luffy; memory-vault stays true; modules retained.

evidence.command: for m in z0r0 luffy; do nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.$m.config.layers.layer-20.services.everos.enable; nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.$m.config.layers.layer-20.services.context-forge.enable; nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.$m.config.layers.layer-20.services.memory-vault.enable; done
evidence.output: everos=false, context-forge=false, memory-vault=true on both z0r0 and luffy. EverOS/context-forge enable removed from ai-agent/ai-server tags and memory-governance dependency block. Modules retained; both toplevels eval clean.

features.name: brain-service local LLM answering (privacy) + dedicated DB role (hardening)
features.behavior: brain-service answer-generation uses local Ollama (llmProvider=ollama default); connects as brain_user/brain_db (non-superuser) with pgvector extension provisioned in brain_db.

evidence.command: nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.z0r0.config.services.ai-services.brain-service.llmProvider && nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.z0r0.config.services.ai-services.brain-service.dbUser && nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.z0r0.config.services.ai-services.brain-service.dbName && python3 -m py_compile layers/70-agents/73-memory/brain_server.py && nix eval --raw .#nixosConfigurations.z0r0.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath && nix eval --raw .#nixosConfigurations.luffy.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath
evidence.output: llmProvider=ollama, dbUser=brain_user, dbName=brain_db; brain_server.py compiles; z0r0 + luffy toplevels eval clean. Runtime deployment/verify pending (luffy offline; local chat model must be pulled).
